verdict.rationale: Payout visibility and accelerated settlement are a fair axis for a payment processor like SumUp, but the evidence pack never mentions payouts, settlement timing, next-day or instant payouts. Generic mentions of 'powerful reporting' and reviewing transactions do not establish payout tracking or payout acceleration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see when each payout lands and speed it up (next-day or instant) when I need the cash
